PERSON.Description: names of people (full, partial, initials, nicknames), including titles with names

ADDRESS.Description: postal addresses, including partial addresses (street, building, postcode)

ID_NUMBER.Description: government, passport, licence, national insurance/social security, bank account, sort code, IBAN or card numbers

ONLINE_ID.Description: IP addresses, usernames, social media handles and URLs identifying a person

AGE.Description: a person's age, exact or approximate (e.g. '42', 'in her forties')

GENDER.Description: explicit statements of gender: titles (Mr, Mrs, Ms, Miss, Mx), male/female, man/woman

COMPANY.Description: company, organisation and trading names and their abbreviations

COMPANY_ID.Description: company registration, VAT, tax or DUNS numbers

DOMAIN.Description: company domain names and web addresses

CONTEXTUAL.Description: indirect identifiers that single out a person or company: distinctive job titles or roles, schools, employers, unusual events, salaries tied to a person

LOCATION.Description: names of cities, towns, regions, counties and countries on their own (for example Paris, Yorkshire, Jordan), when they are places and not people or companies

SECRET.Description: passwords, API keys, access tokens, private keys, connection strings and other credentials
